svg.title: Excel data + PPT templates → generated PPT
svg.desc: Excel supplies data, and PPT templates supply layouts and placeholders. auto-pptx fills the matching templates and combines the slides into one presentation. The daily report example uses five data rows and three template slides to produce one five-slide report.

image.title: Actual DEMO-001 project progress output, slide 2

g.text: Daily report example: 5 Excel rows + 3 template slides → one 5-slide presentation
Simplified inputs; actual output shown. Slide count depends on selected rows and their template references.
